[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]Vanea-san said she'd try to persuade[XENO:n ]
Egil. Will she be all right?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]We have to go after her.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]But how do we get to the shrine from here?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Up ahead is a transporter leading to the shrine.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

But it's inactive. We need to trigger[XENO:n ]
the Verification Devices to activate it.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

We'll find one at the top of each of the four pillars.[XENO:n ]
If we trigger them all, we can use the transporter.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Fiorung, how do you know that-mo?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]Maynus's memories...[XENO:n ]
She tells me these things.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Do you know how to trigger them?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Maybe my body itself is the key.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]OK. Then let's get searching.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
